				local v37 = s1 == "Slaps"

				if v37 then
					v37 = string.find(string.lower(child.Name), "slap")
				end

				if v37 then
					child.Parent = Character
				end
			end
		end
	end

	local v38 = Character:FindFirstChild("Quantum Cloner")

	if not v38 then
		v38 = Backpack:FindFirstChild("Quantum Cloner")
	end

	if v38 then
		TextLabel4.Text = "Status: Cloning..."

		if Backpack == v38.Parent then
			v38.Parent = Character
		end

		_task.wait(0.05)
		v38:Activate()
		_task.wait(0.4)
		TextLabel4.Text = "Status: Clearing..."

		for _, child in ipairs(Character:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("Tool") then
				child.Parent = Backpack
			end
		end

		TextLabel4.Text = "Status: SUCCESS"
	else
		TextLabel4.Text = "Status: Cloner Missing"
	end

	_task.delay(1.5, function()

	end)
